To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
providing a structural model to participants during training can enhance grammar acquisition, but only if the model is used to guide learning rather than simply to generate responses.
providing structural knowledge during training enhances acquisition of an artificial grammar, and this effect depends on the timing and type of information that is highlighted during the training.

it is possible (a) to acquire rich, quickly accessed knowledge of a complex artificial grammar and (b) to do so using a string-edit training task in which the model is used only to acquire experience-based grammar knowledge rather than to generate strings.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the acquisition of rich, highly accurate and quickly accessed knowledge.
developing rich and quickly accessed grammar knowledge, which is a prerequisite for developing an efficient grammar processor.
the role of knowledge in learning, and the role of learning in knowledge development.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the results of this experiment show that the participants who received structural information during training generated more accurate strings than did those who did not receive such information.
our findings demonstrate that it is indeed possible to acquire rich highly accurate and quickly accessed knowledge about an artificial grammar.
the use of model-based knowledge in the form of a grammar diagram can enhance the acquisition of a complex artificial grammar.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the use of models can enhance the acquisition of grammar knowledge.
the model-based knowledge can be a useful tool to enhance grammar acquisition, but only if it is used appropriately.
the model is not enough.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible, with appropriate training, for participants to learn an artificial grammar and that this can be done in a way that is highly accurate and quickly accessible.
, when provided with the right information in the right way, people can acquire rich knowledge of a novel artificial grammar.
providing model-based information during training can be an effective strategy for acquiring knowledge of artificial grammars.
